other_conditions: Minimum of 5 healthy nut‑bearing coconut palms required
Palms must be in the specified age groups (4‑60 years for dwarf/hybrid, 7‑60 years for tall)
Palms must be in a contiguous area/plot; partial insurance of the plantation is not allowed
Insurance is for individual palms, not area‑based
Self‑declaration of age group is acceptable, but false declaration voids the policy
Franchise applies: claim assessed only if loss exceeds 1 palm for <30 palms, 2 palms for 31‑100 palms, 3 palms for >100 palms in a contiguous area
Waiting period: loss/death of palms within 30 days from policy inception is not payable (except on renewal)
benefits_summary: Provides insurance coverage for coconut palms against natural perils with a premium subsidy (50% by CDB, 25% each by state and farmer) and sum insured up to ₹900 for palms aged 4‑15 years and ₹1,750 for palms aged 16‑60 years.
